 Published: October 22, 2026 An online lottery featuring the TV anime LINK CLICK Ⅱ is returning to Kujibikido, the online lottery service operated by KADOKAWA Corporation. The [Resale] LINK CLICK Ⅱ Online Lottery goes on sale on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 5:00 PM.
 The prize lineup includes new illustrations of Toki and Hikaru striking cool poses while seated in chairs. During the sales period, a repost campaign will also be held: 3 people chosen by lottery from those who follow Kujibikido's official X account and repost the designated post will receive the "E Prize: Can Badge Complete Set (all 16 types)."
 [Resale] LINK CLICK Ⅱ Online Lottery Overview
 Sales Period: October 29, 2026 (Thursday) 5:00 PM to November 26, 2026 (Thursday) 4:59 PM
 Price: ¥770 per draw (tax included). A separate shipping fee applies.
 Purchase Page: https://kujibikido.com/lp/link-click_4/ 
 Prize Lineup
 S Prize: Extra-Large Cloth Poster of Your Choice (2 types total)
 A Prize: Acrylic Illustration Board (1 type total)
 B Prize: Acrylic Stand Figure (2 types total)
 C Prize: Acrylic Keychain (6 types total)
 D Prize: Bromide 5-Piece Set (6 types total)
 E Prize: Can Badge (16 types total)
 *Note: One item from among all the types in each prize tier is won.
 X Follow & Repost Campaign
 During the sales period, 3 people chosen by lottery from those who follow Kujibikido's official X account (@kujibikido) and repost the designated post will receive the "E Prize: Can Badge Complete Set (all 16 types)."
 Bonus Campaign 1
 Everyone who purchases a 10-Draw Set receives one "Heart-Shaped Can Badge."
 *5 types total, distributed at random.
 Bonus Campaign 2
 Everyone who purchases a 20-Draw Set receives one "Mini Acrylic Stand."
 *2 types total, distributed at random.
 About Kujibikido
 Kujibikido is a no-lose online lottery that can be played easily from a smartphone or PC, offering plenty of excitement and encounters with your favorite characters.
